content.rendered:
Every morning at 6AM, Gospelbuzz publishes The Gospel For Today to help you start your day grounded in Scripture and grace. Here is a look back at this week’s seven devotionals. Catch up on any you missed or share one with someone who needs it today.

Sunday, May 3: You Are the Righteousness of God

Scripture: 2 Corinthians 5:21
Religion offers improvement. The Gospel offers exchange. You receive, by faith, a righteousness that is not yours by performance but His by nature, gifted to you at the cross, permanent and complete.

Read the full devotional

Monday, May 4: Rooted and Built Up in Him

Scripture: Colossians 2:6-7
The same way you received Christ is the same way you live in Him. Not striving and performing but rooted and built up, drawing from an inexhaustible supply.

Read the full devotional

Tuesday, May 5: There Is Now No Condemnation

Scripture: Romans 8:1
One word carries the full weight of this verse: now. Not after you improve. In Christ Jesus, right now, there is no condemnation. The verdict has been given. Not guilty.

Read the full devotional

Wednesday, May 6: You Have the Mind of Christ

Scripture: 1 Corinthians 2:16
Four words. No qualification, no caveat. We have the mind of Christ. Not a goal to reach. A reality to walk in. You are not limited to your own understanding today.

Read the full devotional

Thursday, May 7: Greater Is He That Is in You

Scripture: 1 John 4:4
You have overcome, past tense, settled, done. Not because of your strength but because of the One in you. Greater is He that is in you than he that is in the world.

Read the full devotional

Friday, May 8: I Am the Vine, You Are the Branches

Scripture: John 15:5
Jesus does not say try harder. He says remain. The branch does not strain to produce fruit. It stays connected and the fruit is the natural result. Your job is connection, not production.

Read the full devotional

Saturday, May 9: The Lord Is My Shepherd, I Lack Nothing

Scripture: Psalm 23:1
Not I lack less. Not I have enough to get by. I lack nothing. The Lord is my shepherd, personal, present, attentive, and in His care the cup does not just fill. It overflows.

Read the full devotional

Coming Up Next Week: May 10 to 16

Theme: The Love That Does Not Let Go

  • Sun May 10: Nothing Can Separate You from His Love (Romans 8:38-39)
  • Mon May 11: He Chose You Before the Foundation of the World (Ephesians 1:4-5)
  • Tue May 12: His Mercy Is New Every Morning (Lamentations 3:22-23)
  • Wed May 13: You Are Hidden with Christ in God (Colossians 3:3)
  • Thu May 14: He Who Calls You Is Faithful (1 Thessalonians 5:24)
  • Fri May 15: Cast All Your Anxiety on Him (1 Peter 5:7)
  • Sat May 16: His Love Never Fails (1 Corinthians 13:8)

New devotionals publish every morning at 6AM. 🙏
